name: Darkon III
description: Darkon III was a planet of the Darkon system, within the Chaama sector, in the Mid Rim and Northern Dependencies regions of the galaxy. In 0 BBY, the corporate criminal Linkaas requested that his employee, the smuggler Dannen Lifehold, make a stop in Darkon III, before proceeding to his destination, the planet Dohu VII. This was in order for Linkaas to gain time to organize a trap on Dohu VII for the smuggler.
